Summary: enterprise financial data search + investigations team. Heavy RAG focus: embeddings + reranking pipeline. Need EU/UK-only residency; multi-region read replicas (eu-west & eu-central) with fast failover to uk-region during office hours.

Highlights / ask:
- Indexing scale: ~120M small docs (statements, legal filings, transaction transcripts) -> expect ~500M vectors after chunking. Concern: long tail updates, delta indexing latency.
- Latency SLO: 95th pct < 75ms for top-k retrieval + reranker; tail sensitive during trading hours.
- Cost sensitivity: target effective cost-per-query (end-to-end) < $0.015 at 100 QPS baseline.
- Model preferences: open models for embeddings (L2-sim), preference for 8-bit quantized reranker variants; fallback to smaller reranker when latency spikes.
- Routing/failover: geo-aware routing, prefer eu-central then eu-west, automatic fallback to uk-read replica only if eu degraded. Also require cross-region encryption in transit and residency guarantees for primary/secondary.
